title: Initial loading state
description: First paint before the feed has responded: the card shows a loading message in place of rows, and the stop-name slot shows a dimmed 'Cargando parada…' placeholder instead of the real stop name.

changes.intent: Show a loading message while the initial departures request is in flight.
changes.detail: Render `.screen__empty` containing a single paragraph 'Cargando información de salidas…' in place of `.arrival-list` until the first successful fetch resolves.

changes.intent: Avoid showing a blank or stale stop name before the stop metadata has loaded.
changes.detail: While stop metadata is unresolved, render the text 'Cargando parada…' in `.screen__stop-name` instead of the real name, styled dimmer via a modifier class.

changes.intent: Visually de-emphasize the placeholder stop name so it reads as pending, not as the actual value.
Reuse the same centered empty-state treatment for the loading message.
